bibliography.title: Article Composite Proton Exchange Membranes Based on Chitosan and Phosphotungstic Acid Immobilized One-Dimensional Attapulgite for Direct Methanol Fuel Cells

mechanism_relevant_findings: The interaction between positively charged CS chains and negatively charged PWA constructs effective proton transport channels with the help of 1D AT.
The proton conductivity of the composite membrane reached 35.3 mS cm − 1 at 80 °C.

numerical_findings.conditions: fed at 2 M methanol, 4% WQAT content

relevance_judgement.reason: The study provides significant insights into proton transport mechanisms in composite membranes.
